title: DungeonGPT.js
description: An AI-powered dungeon master for tabletop RPG adventures. Uses GPT to generate dynamic storylines, NPCs, and encounters in real-time.

title: RPG Loom
description: A deterministic incremental RPG with AI-powered dynamic content generation. Features quest systems, crafting, combat, and multi-provider LLM support for narrative generation.

title: NovelWriter
description: A distraction-free writing application designed for novelists and long-form content creators. Features chapter organization, word count tracking, and export options.

title: Nebula Rush (Sci-Fi Game)
description: A high-speed sci-fi racing game built with React, Three.js, and Tailwind CSS. Inspired by F-Zero.

title: Fantasy Card Game
description: A digital collectible card game with fantasy themes. Features deck building, strategic gameplay, and beautiful card artwork.

title: StoryDaemon
description: StoryDaemon generates long-form fiction through an autonomous agent that plans, writes, and evolves stories organically.

title: PSI Demo
description: A demonstration of Private Set Intersection (PSI) cryptographic protocols. Allows two parties to compute the intersection of their datasets without revealing the full datasets.

title: Roguelike Dungeon Crawler
description: A classic roguelike dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels, turn-based combat, and permadeath. Built with modern web technologies.

title: VRF Loot Generator
description: A demonstration of Verifiable Random Functions (VRFs) for cryptographically secure loot generation. Features an online trading system with commit-reveal protocol to prevent tampering.

title: LiveSlides
description: An AI-native presentation tool for creating media-rich slides. Write presentations in MDX with React components, featuring 10 smooth transitions, presenter view, and camera overlay support.

title: NoBS Recorder
description: A minimal, reliable desktop screen recorder for Linux (X11). Features window/screen capture, microphone support with volume boost, webcam overlay, and auto-save functionality.

title: Voxelholm
description: A from-scratch C++/OpenGL voxel engine and game. Mine, build and explore a procedurally generated world with biomes, caves, crafting, villages and a day/night cycle, heading towards a sandbox RPG. Work in progress.

title: Xaya Roguelike
description: A blockchain roguelike on the Xaya framework. The overworld lives on-chain while dungeon runs play out locally and settle with replay proofs. Includes two-player co-op and staked duels.

title: Spellbound Gridiron
description: A fantasy football strategy game inspired by Blood Bowl. One LLM invents team names and another powers an in-game coach for rules help and tactical advice.

title: Castle Arcade
description: A browser arcade for CastlePalm, a fantasy 16-bit handheld console. Pick a cartridge and play, or write your own in assembly with the CastlePalm SDK.

title: Dragon Hoard
description: My game for Dragon Palm, a fantasy 8-bit handheld console created by 0xe25f. Steer a little dragon around to gobble gems, written in self-modifying assembly for a CPU with just eleven instructions. Playable on my hosted version of Dragon Palm.

title: LLM Creative Writing Analyzer
description: Sends the same creative writing prompt to multiple LLMs, repeatedly, to compare their output and measure consistency and variation.

title: LLM Brain Demo
description: A working proof that a company "LLM brain" is a router with governed tools, not a single vector database. One chat interface over a synthetic company, with text-to-SQL and hybrid document search, and permissions enforced by Postgres.

title: Prompt Injection Testing
description: A research tool comparing prompt injection detectors side by side: LLM classifiers, regex patterns, BERT models, cheap LLM pre-filters and ScrambleGate.

title: Rysk APR Monitor
description: A real-time dashboard comparing Rysk's income premium APRs against theoretical Black-Scholes APRs to spot mispriced income.

title: Crypto Trading Dashboard
description: A real-time crypto trading dashboard with a live order book heatmap, cumulative volume delta, price charts and open interest.

title: PromptDesk
description: A minimalist AI desktop that runs entirely in the browser. Notes, folders and chat windows connected to OpenAI, Claude or Gemini, all saved locally.

title: Clipsmith
description: A lightweight Linux desktop app for trimming and stitching video clips. A no-nonsense Electron GUI over ffmpeg, with no re-encoding unless you ask for it.

title: ISO Standards Study Hub
description: A small static web app for studying ISO standards with flashcards and multiple-choice quizzes. Decks cover information security, risk management and AI.

title: VantageTerm
description: A lightweight desktop companion for Claude Code and other CLI agents: a multi-tab terminal, a file tree with git status, and side-by-side diffs for reviewing what changed.

title: plimsoll
description: An autonomous build loop for long unsupervised work. From one prompt it writes its own spec and checklist, then builds item by item, committing only what passes verification.

title: LLM Remote Runner
description: A secure web interface for running LLM and coding-agent tasks remotely, with password authentication, multiple backends and real-time streaming output.

title: ProjectShelf
description: A local-first desktop app that indexes your projects folder for fast browsing and search, with git status and recent-activity tracking.

title: webscan
description: A security testing orchestrator for web apps. Wraps open-source scanners and custom checks into one CLI with 16 modules, a 150+ item checklist and unified reports.
